{{Quote|Awaiting confirmation of completed objectives: elimination of Republic air defenses and coordinate tagging of enemy targets.|44-ND|<ref name="TOR" />}}
'''44-ND''' was a [[Probe droid/Legends|probe droid]] in the service of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Galactic War]] with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="TOR" />

[[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Hestun]] used 44-ND to contact Imperial operatives via the droid's in-built hologram, recruiting an Imperial strike force to disable three Republic anti-aircraft emplacements on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]], as well as using the tags provided by 44-ND to mark Imperial aerial-bombardment targets on the world by hiding beacons within designated Republic encampments. Targets included a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] encampment, that of the [[Corellian Jedi|Green Jedi]], and a Republic [[Communications relay/Legends|Comm Station]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
According to the game's conversation files, 44-ND was originally named NN-4D.
